rules.summary: Inline // comment added in a Kotlin source body
rules.message: House rule: zero inline // comments inside function bodies. State the WHAT in a concise KDoc if the contract is non-obvious; rationale belongs in the PR description. See CONTRIBUTING.md (AS-1).

A one-line /* */ or /** */ is an inline comment with different delimiters; the same house rule applies. A KDoc that is genuinely needed uses the multi-line block form above the declaration. See CONTRIBUTING.md (AS-1).

rules.summary: Plain clickable() used instead of clickableNoFocus
rules.message: Interactive UI must use clickableNoFocus (ui/util/Modifiers.kt) so touch input does not steal gamepad focus. See CONTRIBUTING.md (dual-modality).

rules.summary: Hardcoded dp literal added in UI code
rules.message: Dimensions route through Dimens / tokens.json, not literals (0.dp excepted). See CONTRIBUTING.md (design tokens).

A save channel and its states move together. These primitives each move one half, so calling one directly leaves the other half behind - the states of a renamed channel keep the old name, the states of a deleted channel come back on the next sync. Route through domain/usecase/savechannel (ActivateSaveChannelUseCase and siblings), which owns both halves. States remain an independent peer elsewhere: their own sync paths, gates and UI do not go through here. See .claude/skills/investigate/coupling-map.md (SAVE-SYNC axis).

rules.summary: Save config resolved without a platform
rules.message: getConfig and getConfigByPackage answer for an emulator, not for a platform, so a multi-platform emulator resolves to whichever layout is listed first. That is how the Wii row came to display GameCube's path and how both platforms came to share one override row (#380). Ask SavePathAuthority instead: it takes the platform slug as a required argument and returns the layout, the override key, the evaluated path and a validation verdict together. The registry itself and the authority are excluded; everything else goes through the authority.

domain/ is Compose-free, and unlike the Android-framework debt this one has no exceptions. A use case that needs to describe state returns a plain type; the UI layer decides how to hold it. See AGENTS.md (Architecture).

rules.summary: ui/ importing a game, platform or collection DAO
rules.message: ui/ reaches game, platform and collection data through repositories, never the DAO. The existing violators are a known list that is not being extended. See AGENTS.md (Architecture) and the code-quality skill.

Hiding the system bars has one owner: util/ImmersiveMode.kt (installImmersiveMode + Window.hideSystemBars). Four activities each carried their own copy and drifted into four different states; one of them silently broke the IME by returning the wrong insets. Call the shared functions instead. See AGENTS.md (Dual-screen OSOT).

rules.summary: Box-art focus treatment written outside BoxArtFrame.kt
rules.message: How cover art reacts to focus has one owner: ui/components/BoxArtFrame.kt (Modifier.boxArtFrame). GameCard kept a byte-identical copy of the glow-mode block that nothing read, which is the shape that drifts the moment either side is edited. Pass artworkGradient to boxArtFrame instead. See AGENTS.md (Architecture).
